construction.proof:
WHOLE-OWNER RETURN AFTER RELEASING AUXILIARY PATCH WALLS

The predecessor is a complete native packing obtained by gluing complete
published-source patches. Its module boxes prove compatibility, but those
box walls are not actual obstacles to the contained prisms. Retain every
whole owner, its source word and its proper frame. Remove only those
auxiliary box walls. For each pair choose an actual separating direction
from the two sets of prism face normals and cross products of prism edges.
The separating-axis theorem makes this list complete for convex polyhedra.
Every chosen direction must already separate the full predecessor pair.

With these directions fixed, solve one common linear system in all owner
translations and the single host scale: all actual prism vertices must
satisfy every host wall; each pair must satisfy its actual directed support
inequality. Whole source frames and all owner labels remain fixed. The
old packing is a feasible control. Further returns may choose different
already-realized separators from the preceding complete packing; record
every such predecessor and its all-pair directions. No metric angle is a
variable, and no independently optimized marginal state is combined.

Every retained finite witness embeds its complete parent native record and
SHA256, the source mark/word data inherited through that record, all fixed
frames, every realized contact step, and the new complete native packing.
Official exact-input host/all-pair verification is required. Numerical LP
success alone is not certification, and LP failure is not an obstruction.

construction.proof:
PENTAGON DOUBLE-LATTICE PATCHES AND FULL LAYERS

Use the complete published source in prism5_source/DOUBLE_LATTICE_SOURCE.json.
Write bx=B00, by=B11, mx=m1.x, R=k0.x, A=-k2.x, U=k1.y.
For columns i=0,...,a-1 and rows j=0,...,b-1, take source owner
(i,floor(j/2),j mod2), at (i bx+(j mod2)mx,j by/2) with frame
I for even j and diag(-1,-1,1) for odd j. Every patch owner is a
complete member of the proved infinite source; all pair separators remain.

For b=1 the exact x interval is [-A,(a-1)bx+R]. For b>=2 it is
[-A,(a-1)bx+mx+A], because the odd-row extrema dominate on the right
and the even-row extrema dominate on the left. These order comparisons
are checked in the canonical field. The y interval is [-U,(b-1)by/2+U].
Thus patch dimensions are
  (a bx + 1[b>=2](mx+A-R), 2U+(b-1)by/2, L).
Keep the midpoints of those full intervals, not only center ranges.

Place complete patches in three cyclic axis orientations. Each layer is
a full rectangular patch grid; each orientation's thickness is its full
intrinsic dimension. Concatenate the selected layer word and sum every
thickness. The common cube side is the maximum of this total thickness
and both transverse extents of every layer. Different boxes separate on
a coordinate wall, while all owners inside each box inherit the source
proof. Delete only the declared whole-owner suffix to obtain the requested
count; retain every parent word and the actual box dimensions.

The boundary search evaluates exact construction events numerically; this
is only candidate generation. The formula above and the full native check
certify every accepted witness. It does not imply global optimality.

HETEROGENEOUS DOUBLE-LATTICE PATCH COMPOSITION

Keep the full physical patch and both ends from PENTAGON_DOUBLE_PATCH_PROOF.
Permute its axes by one of the six stored proper cube rotations. A row is
an integer number of identical complete patches; its height and depth are
full patch dimensions. A layer concatenates rows sharing one full depth.
The complete packing concatenates these layers. No partial prism is used.

Costs are represented by nonnegative integer vectors in the ordered basis
(bx, mx+A-R, U/2, 1/2) from the exact canonical source field. Thus a patch's
three intrinsic dimensions have vectors (a,1[b>1],0,0), (0,0,3b+1,0), and
(0,0,0,2L). Record the entire row and layer word; coordinate walls separate
distinct module boxes. Count recursion minimizes a row/layer's full cost
for each total owner capacity up to100, capping the index only while keeping
the complete last module and true parent count. Numerical bisection locates
candidate words; final side is recomputed from all actual word costs and
all transverse extents. Neither the bisection bound nor an asserted grammar
minimum is needed for validity. Exact-input native checks certify witnesses.
construction.cost_convention: Each integer quadruple denotes its dot product with(bx,mx+A-R,U/2,1/2)in the canonical source field. Every module cost includes both full ends.
construction.native_decoder: Read complete_parent_assembly.word in order as full layers, centered in z. Read layer.rows.word as full rows, centered in y; each has module_count full patches centered in x. Source owner(u,v) is at(u*bx+(v mod2)*mx,v*by/2,0), with parity frame I or diag(-1,-1,1). Subtract the module midpoint(((a-1)*bx+(mx if b>1 else R-A))/2,(b-1)*by/4,0). Apply proper module quaternion and compose it on the left of the parity quaternion. Add full cell center. Retain exactly retained_owner_words, multiply centers by1.0000001 and inflate common host by the same factor plus1e-7.
